title: Diagnostic Sweep

story.briefing: Sector 3 stores its charge across a numbered bank of cells. The Core will not route power any further without a total.
story.success: Charge total accepted. Sector 3 releases the lock.

description: Return the sum of every integer from 1 up to and including n. If n is less than 1, return 0.
hints: Keep a running total and add to it once per cell.
Your loop needs to include n itself, not stop just before it. Off-by-one errors live here.
Start a total at 0, loop i from 1 through n adding each i, then return the total. A negative n means the loop never runs, which already returns 0.
